wave: TOKYO PRIORITY D HIGH-YIELD ADOPT IMPLEMENTATION
scopeBoundary: Only the three ADOPTs from tokyo-priority-d-high-yield-preflight-2026-08-25 were implemented. The two current/current-linked issuer charts named for each venue were visually transcribed twice; no candidate discovery or new venue research was performed.
policyBasis: The second pass was a fresh visual reread of the issuer PDF by row/block and number sequence before comparison with the first pass. PASS requires the complete printed set, issuer-defined ownership/subtotals and selected configuration to match. Published capacity was never used to fill a number, gap, ownership relation or configuration difference.

venues.venue: たましんRISURUホール 小ホール

issuerMetadata.wheelchairPlacement: approximately four wheelchairs, two on each side

firstPass.method: Fresh full-page visual transcription by the printed row labels 1-10 and every displayed number sequence.

secondPass.method: Independent visual reread by side/centre/side blocks and then row subtotal, without using the first-pass range string as an answer key.

comparison.rowAndAreaOwnership: MATCH: each range is owned by the issuer-printed row number; no geometry-only area was made.
comparison.issuerSubtotals: MATCH: 98 removable rows1-4 plus the issuer's separately named 12 convertible row9-10 positions is metadata within the full246 set.
comparison.twoPassAgreement: MATCH: both passes produce the same complete 246 printed IDs.

outcome.accessibilityAndRemovableMetadata: All 110 removable printed seats remain selectable. The issuer labels row9-10 positions1-3 and24-26 as wheelchair-usable removable seats; it does not define a replacement relation to ordinary IDs, so none was inferred.

venues.venue: 杉並公会堂 小ホール

officialEvidence.representativeConfiguration: current issuer A-J numbered small-hall layout

firstPass.method: Fresh full-page visual transcription of the printed A-J sequences.

secondPass.method: Independent visual reread from the PDF's three printed blocks per row, followed by row-count arithmetic before comparison.
secondPass.subtotals: A16 + B-I160 + J14 =190; unnumbered wheelchair icons4 are separate.

comparison.rowAndAreaOwnership: MATCH: the issuer prints each A-J row label and all owned numbers.
comparison.rangesAndGaps: MATCH: A starts3 and J starts4/ends17; B-I are full1-20.
comparison.issuerSubtotals: MATCH: the PDF explicitly states 190 seats plus wheelchair4; no capacity fitting occurred.
comparison.twoPassAgreement: MATCH: both passes produce the same complete 190 printed IDs.

outcome.accessibilityAndRemovableMetadata: The four wheelchair spaces are unnumbered metadata only. No wheelchair ID was created and no printed A-J seat was removed.

venues.venue: 大泉学園ゆめりあホール

officialEvidence.representativeConfiguration: current issuer 170 fixed plus six individually numbered wheelchair spaces

firstPass.method: Fresh full-page visual transcription of rows A-M and the separately printed wheelchair numbers.

secondPass.method: Independent reread of the fixed-seat row subtotal first, then the six issuer-labelled wheelchair symbols before comparison.
secondPass.subtotals: A6 + B12 + C-L140 + M12 = fixed170; wheelchair1-6=6; total176.

comparison.rowAndAreaOwnership: MATCH: rows A-M and the grouped wheelchair1-6 positions are issuer-labelled; display areas only preserve those explicit groups.
comparison.rangesAndGaps: MATCH: A/B/M endpoints and M gaps4/11, plus wheelchair1-6.
comparison.twoPassAgreement: MATCH: both passes produce the same complete 176 printed IDs.

outcome.accessibilityAndRemovableMetadata: The six wheelchair positions have individual issuer IDs and remain selectable; no accessibility-based exclusion was made.
